question: Do lagged PMI and monetary conditions interact with previously estimated industry sensitivities to improve ranking?
hypotheses: Growth-sensitive industries respond differently to persistent manufacturing conditions
M2 acceleration may proxy financing conditions but is not equity buying power
sources: R11 archived manufacturing PMI and M2 YoY, revised historical proxy; L1/L2/L3 synthetic baskets separately

states.money: exact 3 economic-month change in M2 YoY divided by100

availability: economic month end +45 calendar days main; +75 delay sensitivity; strictly earlier than signal; no claimed verified original release dates
sensitivity: per era/level/industry, trailing36 calendar months before signal, >=24 complete monthly observations; regress known past_excess20 at s on macro state known at prior completed month-end s-1; training-standardized joint Ridge alpha1 with intercept; no current/future return included
features: exposure-only = mean of two standardized slopes; macro-conditioned = sum(slope_j * (current_state_j-train_mean_j)/train_sd_j); no calendar-year taxonomy pooling
cohort: exact common rows for both45/75 lags and all methods; >=20 signal industries, unknown future outcomes retained; separate coverage bylag
target: unchanged R01 t+1 close entry;20 primary/60 secondary excess vs CSI_ALL
evaluation: date IC >=20 known outcomes; top quintile selected before outcomes; suppress incomplete group return, no replacements; date equal averages; annual summaries
comparisons: F_macro minus F, and F_macro minus F_exposure; two comparisons x five era/level strata=10 primary tests at45days
uncertainty: R01 circular6month bootstrap2000, alpha .05/10; 24months minimum, >=2/3 years positive; require delay75 mean increment positive on samecohort; secondary horizon descriptive
boundaries: No factor or window search after results
Industry slopes are empirical historical exposure, not a causal economic coefficient
Macro vintage/release and membership uncertainty remain
Fixed-horizon group return less 2*20/50bps is diagnostic, not a tradable strategy
No full style control; exposure-only separates dynamic state from static exposure but does not prove full independence
